title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Cryptosporidium spp. in Stool Samples
author: Asar Khan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r49d8z6

steps.title: Bead lysis and buffer addition
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis and initial buffer treatments on the stool sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 g stool to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and add 500 mg (0.5 g) glass beads.
Add 1 mL SLX‑buffer and vortex at maximum speed for 5 min.
Add 100 µL DS‑Buffer, vortex for 3 min, then incubate at 70 °C for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 3 min at room temperature; transfer 800 µL supernatant to a new tube.
Add 270 µL P2‑Buffer, vortex thoroughly, and incubate on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 3 min; transfer the entire supernatant to a fresh 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add EB and HTR reagents
steps.instruction: Introduce elution buffer and HTR reagent, then clarify the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL EB (Elution Buffer) to the tube, pulse‑vortex, and incubate at 70 °C for 10–20 min to dissolve the DNA pellet.
Add 100 µL HTR Reagent, vortex for 10 s, and incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 2 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL (0.7 volume) isopropanol to the tube and invert 20–30 times to mix.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the DNA pellet.
Invert the tubes on a paper towel for 1 min to drain residual liquid.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins and add XP1 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL Proteinase‑K to each 1.5 mL tube, vortex thoroughly, and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.
Add XP1‑Buffer equal to the sample volume (≈1.5 mL) and vortex.

steps.title: Column binding and first wash
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to spin column and perform the first wash with XP1 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Insert a spin column into a 2 mL collection tube and transfer 600 µL of the sample onto the column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min; discard the flow‑through.
Add 300 µL XP1 Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: SPW wash steps
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with SPW wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Insert the column into a new 2 mL collection tube, add 700 µL SPW Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.
Repeat the addition of 700 µL SPW Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Ethanol removal and elution incubation
steps.instruction: Dry the column and incubate with elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 14,000 × g for 2 min to remove residual ethanol.
Place the column into a clean 2 mL Eppendorf tube, add 60 µL Elution Buffer directly onto the membrane centre, and incubate at 70 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Final DNA elution and storage
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the column twice and store the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 1 min to collect the first eluate.
Add a second 60 µL of Elution Buffer and repeat centrifugation at 14,000 × g for 1 min.
Discard the spin column and store the combined eluate at –20 °C until downstream amplification.
